basics.name: Lex Brugman
basics.label: Engineering Leader
basics.summary: Engineering leader with a strong product and delivery mindset. Experienced in building and scaling distributed platforms, leading multi-team engineering organizations, and driving technical and organizational change. Combines hands-on technical depth with leadership in hiring, coaching, execution, and platform strategy.

highlights: Represented engineering in the management team and contributed to company-level strategy
Led ~20 engineers across 5 cross-functional teams (frontend, backend, QA)
Improved delivery predictability by introducing clearer structure, ownership, and processes
Implemented DORA metrics to drive engineering health and continuous improvement
Built and coached a stronger leadership layer within engineering
Professionalized performance management and development practices across the organization
Owned the technology roadmap and architectural direction of the platform
Stack: Python, React.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS
work.summary: Drove engineering leadership, team development, and organizational maturity at Agriplace preparing for a critical growth stage.

Head of Engineering since 2020, Manager/Team lead since 2018
